source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "ដំណាំក្រូចថ្លុង" (Pomelo Cultivation Guide), 2017, 90pp
text: The source notes that, as with other fruit crops sold on the world market, pomelo prices vary and are not fixed; farmers should expect price fluctuation depending on supply and season. As an indicative figure from the source, farmers might sell fruit at roughly 5,000 to 6,000 riel per fruit, with a well-managed mature orchard capable of producing on the order of 400 to 600 fruit per tree per year (figure as printed in the source; farmers should treat this as an example rather than a guarantee, since yield varies with tree age, variety, and management).
